system.special: <p><strong><p><strong>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Crystal: </strong> </strong> &lt;/strong&gt; Lawful, similar to White; breath cold or crystal; 50% asleep; 10% talking.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Onyx: Neutral, similar to Black; breath acid or darkness; 40% asleep; 20% talking.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Jade: Neutral, similar to Green; breath chlorine gas or disease; 30% asleep; 30% talking.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Sapphire: Lawful, similar to Blue; breath lightning or vaporize; 20% asleep; 40% talking.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Ruby: Lawful, similar to Red; breath fire and melt; 10% asleep; 50% talking.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Amber: Chaotic, similar to Gold; breath fire and melt, gas and disease; 5% asleep; 100% talking.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/p&gt;</p></p>
system.description: Gemstone dragons are six distinct varieties: Crystal, Onyx, Jade, Sapphire, Ruby and Amber (or brown). Each is similar to a standard dragon colour and has its own alignment, breath weapon, sleeping chance and chance of speech.
